focus_areas: Feather texture realism and individual strand definition

Anatomical correctness of the visible head structures

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the golden hackles and the dark body feathers. AI often smears these textures. Also, evaluate if the background blur looks optically realistic or algorithmically uniform. The foreground subject's head anatomy is the primary source of truth for alignment.
image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a rooster (cock) in the foreground, facing right. The bird features vibrant golden-orange hackle feathers, a bright red comb and wattle, and dark iridescent body plumage. A second rooster is visible in the background, slightly out of focus, standing on green grass.

expert_testimonies.reason: To confirm the specific breed characteristics and ensure it is classified correctly as a cock and not a hen or other bird.
To verify the spatial relationship between the foreground and background roosters and ensure the ground plane is consistent.
To check for edge bleeding between the complex hackle feathers and the background, ensuring clean segmentation.
To analyze the texture consistency of the feathers and detect any subtle generative noise or smoothing artifacts.
